bookings_completed_requires_fields.name: bookings_completed_requires_fields
bookings_completed_requires_fields.value: "bookings"."status" <> 'completed' OR ("bookings"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."gallery_published_at" IS NOT NULL)

bookings_gallery_expires_requires_publis.name: bookings_gallery_expires_requires_published
bookings_gallery_expires_requires_publis.value: "bookings"."gallery_expires_at" IS NULL OR "bookings"."gallery_published_at" IS NOT NULL

contracts_signed_requires_fields.name: contracts_signed_requires_fields
contracts_signed_requires_fields.value: "contracts"."status" <> 'signed' OR ("contracts"."accepted" = true AND "contracts"."signed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "contracts"."signed_name" IS NOT NULL AND "contracts"."signed_email" IS NOT NULL)

date_reservations_hold_requires_fields.name: date_reservations_hold_requires_fields
date_reservations_hold_requires_fields.value: "date_reservations"."status" <> 'hold' OR ("date_reservations"."hold_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "date_reservations"."confirmed_at" IS NULL)

date_reservations_confirmed_requires_fie.name: date_reservations_confirmed_requires_fields
date_reservations_confirmed_requires_fie.value: "date_reservations"."status" <> 'confirmed' OR ("date_reservations"."hold_expires_at" IS NULL AND "date_reservations"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)

payments_partially_refunded_requires_fie.name: payments_partially_refunded_requires_fields
payments_partially_refunded_requires_fie.value: "payments"."status" <> 'partially_refunded' OR ("payments"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."refunded_cents" > 0 AND "payments"."refunded_cents" < "payments"."amount_cents")
